title: Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic Syrian-style lamb kebab recipe, perfect for a quick dinner or outdoor barbecue.

ingredients.name: Lamb
ingredients.notes: preferably leg of lamb, cut into 1-inch cubes

instructions: In a large bowl, combine lamb, Syrian spice blend, roasted garlic paste, nimble, salt, and black pepper.
Mix well to combine and let marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread lamb onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush olive oil onto the grates.
Grill lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with chopped onion and bell pepper on the side.
